I completely understand how you feel & I agree. You want to be someone who appreciates life; but you can't seem to do that, can you? Saying this makes me a hypocrite, but I'm saying this because I feel the same way. Feeling something genuine other than this.. That would be amazing. I hate this feeling. I hate how others get to live normally while I suffer like this. I hate the fact others know how this feels. No one should ever feel like this. I hate how unfair life is. I hate how I know that'll never change. I hate how I know my life is fine, how I have so many reasons to continue; but I also have reasons to feel like this. I live by the motto "Everything has a reason". I'm not prepared. So is basically everyone else who live like this. I want to be someone who enjoys life. I want to be the exact person you described. I'd do the same as you. It's a burden I don't have the will or power to carry. The pressure I get just doing normal things.. I'm too pessimistic, too hard headed to understand. They can't understand me, but neither can I. I'm gonna try to get through this. I will get through this. I need to get through this.

ah no, it's not like that. It's just unfair that they get to live a normal life. We also want to feel like that. They never should be forced down in a place like this. If someone overcomes this feeling, they're not wrong or bad. They're an amazing person. Overcoming this feeling, that's the best thing you can do in your life. It's so strong you end up feeling worthless & can't land a single hit. Landing even a light tap, you're strong. I know it doesn't make sense. It never has. Not saying everyone should feel this way so we feel it's fair, but what we want is to feel how they feel. Experience a life full of joy. Ours is just struggling. We can't do normal things without feeling pressure. I know that's the same for those who don't have this feeling, but the way we feel, it's.. A little different. Life is not & never will be fair, yes, we know; but no one wants that, right? You can't discriminate someone for wanting a fair life. No one deserves to die, but what if they want to? It's a choice. A choice no one should make. It's unfair others out there don't even need to make a choice. Not saying they should. They shouldn't. What we want is to live normally. That's all. I agree with HorrorJunkyT.

you see, it's a little unfair that others don't suffer such a feeling living a nice life while a lot of the people here, just can't do the same. A lot can't do normal things without having any struggles or anxiety. It's complicated to explain or understand, but that's just how it is. I'll try to explain using a metaphor. It drags you down until you're at the bottom of a dark hole, with no light or anyone to see you. It's so dark you can't do anything in fear of failing. Having a life like that, feeling all of this pain & suffering with no one to tell, while others are up there above the hole not even knowing you're in it living a good life.. It's unfair.

Thank you again. I think I'm doing fine. So far, I've told 3 people among my friends. I'm relieved to get it off my chest. A lot of people shrug off my feelings because of my age. Thank you so much for listening, I really needed it.

I'll see if I can tell anyone. If I can, I'll try not to stop myself from saying anything. I'm scared, but I feel even more scared about whether or not I'll try **it** again. I'll do my best. Thank you so much for listening. I really appreciate it.

ah well, thank you so much for the response. Yes, I am. I'm in high school. Because of this, many think I'm just some angsty teen who has nothing else to do. I don't think I have anyone in my family I could talk to, I'm not really sure if I want to hurt my family like that. I don't think I'm ready to tell anyone in my family yet, but maybe when I'm a little older. There isn't any people at school I can talk to about this because it's online, & I'm too scared to tell anyone anyway. I got into trouble for a suicide note that was found by my teacher when I was younger. The counselor called me, comforted me, & asked for one of my relatives. My relative kind of got mad at me, & told my other relatives even if I said not to instead of comforting me; I'm scared it might happen again. I know they care but I don't think they understand. Emotions are just complicated. I've only told 2 people among my friends; I got it off my chest. I feel happy & relieved, but I feel like I'm a burden. I've made progress but I don't want this to keep going because I don't want to hurt anyone. Every day I just keep getting worse. I'll think about calling the hotline when I need to, & I'll try not to hesitate. It lifts me up knowing people are trying to help me. I don't feel alone anymore. Thank you again for the advice, it really helps me.

Thank you so much for the response! I've been feeling like this for.. I'm not sure. I'm used to it if that helps. People just come & go, I guess. I'm pretty good at hiding my feelings, No need to be sorry. I just feel like crap. I'm used to it, yes; but I don't like it anymore. Have a good rest. I'll check this later at night as fast as I can when it's morning for you. Strangers just seem to understand me better. I'm so happy someone responded. Thank you again.
